notes.title: Ready for Devlog#5 - Creating an Enforcer Character
notes.content:
[h1]Hello there Officers![/h1]

[h3]Welcome back to the development log for [i]Ready for Riot[/i]![/h3]

In todays devlog i will show you how we made a character. It's not just [i]any [/i]character - you play as this on!!!! Or your friends. So you will be seeing those LAW ENFORCERS a lot.

[h1] Getting Up Close and Personal (With an Eyeball)[/h1]

We're diving into the nitty-gritty of character creation by starting with something that's often overlooked – the eyeball! Let's see how we're taking this ocular adventure to the next level :D
Also yes, you can create one eyeball and use it in two places in one character.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42179537/3f0bf98692a24422b2758f2e9c5d22a40c2dc2e8.gif[/img]

[h1]Tactical Vest Design[/h1]

Let's see some of the enforcer's gear - the tactical vest. This piece is the embodiment of readiness and protection!! (but still you have only 100 HP)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42179537/0d82949c07963f59db3d94a3958a160285d07117.gif[/img]

[h1]Helmet - wear it or lose your head - choice is yours[/h1]

The Helmet - Safeguarding our enforcer from harm!!
Form meets dunction: Our helmet design is a blend of sleek aesthetics and practicality.

But wait a minute, why is he sooooo ugly :D Maybe he forgetted to shave before work :D
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42179537/cdefcd505c674a3a4128bfee0b86f687c525d030.gif[/img]

[b][h1]ANIMATIONS[/h1][/b]

[h1]Legs Animations[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42179537/e006e988f7fbd010427f2ca3de7b9d8907a4bbb1.gif[/img]

Our enforcer can seamlessly transition from standing to crouching, thanks to dynamic animations. 
This not only adds to the realism but also enhances gameplay by allowing players to take cover or stealthily navigate tight spaces.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42179537/874ea56b062f40e2c53ff2513d08e2685ffb35f5.gif[/img]

[h1]Hands Animations[/h1]

When our SWAT enforcer wields a weapon, you can see the mastery in every movement. 
Our animations focus on the dexterity and finesse needed to manipulate firearms and gadgets (like handcuffs)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42179537/ccfd1482779fa4a7f93bc279a436b6ab96843db1.gif[/img]


[h1]Ready for....[/h1]

Scrupulous sculpting and texturing have given our character depth and authenticity. 
Whether it's the intricacies of the eyeballs or the reflective tactical vest - each detail is carefully crafted! So you can play a more immersive game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42179537/aa7d363211af8d3ca6d87125d4b1b7c2ad198a1f.gif[/img]

[h1]...Riot![/h1]

Throughout the development process, we've strived to balance the serious demands of a enforcer's role with the unique quirks and even some humor that make our character memorable.
Stay tuned for more updates as we continue to bring our characters to life in [i]Ready for Riot![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42179537/6bd4452d1116765baf2c1d373113448fb5a782ae.gif[/img]

So, are you [b]ready[/b]? [b]Ready for Riot[/b]!

Best regards,
Baked Games Team

notes.title: Steam Next Festival - New Demos for Neuroshima Hex and Hammer of Pain!
notes.content:
[h1]Special announcement![/h1]

Hello travelers!

We hope you're all set to dive into the gaming extravaganza that is [b]Steam Next Festival[/b]!

These demos will be available at the start of [b]Steam Next Festival[/b] on [b]9th October 2023![/b]

Calling all strategic masterminds! Get ready to flex your tactical muscles with our revamped [i]Neuroshima Hex[/i] demo. 
It's the perfect way to dip your toes into the world of Mad Max-inspired battles, where every move counts. 
The demo even supports [b]online multiplayer[/b], so you can test your skills against players from around the world!
[h3]
Click here to play the Neuroshima Hex demo right now![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2324150?utm_source=CCdv       

[b][h1]Hammer of Pain Demo:[/h1][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40856629/bc2e46b72456d562a897c529c3df0739a734e224.gif[/img]

[h3]Click here to play the Hammer of Pain demo right now![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2438440/Hammer_of_Pain/?utm_source=CCdv 

[h3]Community and Contest:[/h3]

We want to hear feedback from you! Share your demo experiences, epic victories, and hilarious defeats with the gaming community on Steam or our [b]Discord[/b] server. 

Speaking of Discord, during the festival, we'll be hosting a special [b]CONTEST[/b] on our official server!

What are the rules? You play our demos and aim to be the very best! You can then win great prizes! More info on the Discord server.

notes.title: A new game about being prisoner announced!
notes.content:
[b][h1]Hello dear Players![/h1][/b]

We got special announcement for you!

We already made an game about prison and ist's called a [i]Prison Simulator[/i]. You play as a guard and its up to you to decide how things should run in this penitentiary complex.
[i]Ready for Riot [/i]will be an extension to this "prison-like" genre - you will encounter nothing but a riots in prison (talk about bad day at the offcie, eh?)
But we recently announced a third game in our  "prison-like" genre!
[h1][i]Prison Survival: Architect of Crime Simulator[/i] is the game you've been waiting for!
[/h1]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xR3GLtT1bxI

Step into the shoes of a an inmate and embark on an immersive journey through the world of correctional facilities. ;)

[h3][b]A True-to-Life Experience:[/b][/h3]

[i]Prison Survival[/i] goes above and beyond typical gaming experiences by presenting players with an authentic portrayal of life behind bars. 
As a prisoner, your decisions and actions will directly impact the dynamics within the facility. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42179537/c289d2b11601d2b4fcf173cfbaec3ffa89a2a0ad.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Realistic Challenges:[/b][/h3]

In this captivating simulation, you'll face numerous challenges that mirror the real-life complexities of prison.
The game's dynamic AI ensures that every interaction and decision you make has realistic consequences, challenging your strategic thinking! (and fast hands)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42179537/5c5cc47a075cd8f47abd61eb5a74b3ad10c3d188.png[/img]

[h3][b]In-Game Prisoner Creator:[/b][/h3]

Prison Survival allows you to unleash your creativity by designing your own prisoner. 
Give him unique characteristics, like a unique tatoo!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42179537/25cd5bd916e47055b7633f77fb10b128f42aaff5.png[/img]

[h3]Don't wait! Wishlist today :D[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1983910/Prison_Survival_Architect_of_Crime_Simulator/


Baked Games Team

notes.title: Ready for Devlog#2 - Some behind a scene footage
notes.content:
[h1]Hello there Officers![/h1]

Are you ready? Ready for Riot? In this short devlog i will show you some of behind the scenes footage from developing a Ready For Riot game!

[h3]Ready for action![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42179537/12856aa53c0ac88b6ad08381093767cca337d0e0.gif[/img]

Looking good? Light, camera, action! Especially[b] light[/b]. I really like this scene! In van you can speak with your collagues and hear what they have to say. Probably they are stressed! 

[h3]Technical stuff - vault over obstacles[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42179537/15e2e66a25d25167166cc5ac6a0aafeff21011c7.gif[/img]

Don't worry there will be great graphic assets here, it's just a "test grounds".
What it is exactly? Our programmers and animators works on a way to get our characters more [b]actions and movement skills. [/b]
Here you can see a classic "[b]press space to vault[/b]" as i call it. It will be useful in prison riot where we will have a lot of destroyed things in the corridors.

Why there is a [b]guy with a cowboy[/b] hat in in? Well because we use this method also for our other game - [i]Alaska Gold Fever. [/i]
Check this out!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1674200/Alaska_Gold_Fever/

We are gonna use this to have our character vault over pile of woods in snowy forests of Alaska.
Also our developer left this huge [b]man-mannequin [/b]in the scene for tests and i can't resisted to made a dummy [b]meme [/b]of it ;)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42179537/85eecc919da99b4597db66e963152629be03ffa0.jpg[/img]


[h3]New prison[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42179537/d291da9cbef0a0a231296dd99aaad1c1924675b2.gif[/img]

They will be a lot of levels but most of them are different prisons. 
Take a look at this one. It's more [b]dark[/b] and [b]gloomy[/b] from the one you see in [i]Prison Simulator...[/i]
Also you can see there is a lot of things going on on the scene ;)

[h3]Enemies[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42179537/ce6881815a558c451b0a67eba2adab6cd26993f3.gif[/img]

New prison, new problems! We must set enemies on scene but not randomly!
Here you can see this T-posing fella right in his cozy cell. 
When i hit a button his animations will be set in motion and he will start to attacking me!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42179537/b7ab367f054ce7364283d359a5a5055e1aabee06.png[/img]

Also you have to watch out for ambushes and other traps! This one looks kinda creepy in editor so i decided to show it to you :D



More info soon ;) 
Feel free to ask us in comments below or join our discord community with over 3000 members!
Also check out our cool trailer on YouTube ;)
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VgQAJZBr-es

So, are you [b]ready[/b]? [b]Ready for Riot[/b]!

Best regards,
Baked Games Team

notes.title: Ready for Devlog#1 - Getting started
notes.content:
[h1]Hello there Officers![/h1]

Are you ready? Ready for Riot? In this short devlog i will tell you a some basics rules of this game!

Remember our [b]Prison Simulator[/b] game? Ofc you do ;)
Remember a [b]riot[/b] event that can occur if your prisoner's respect is low?
Probably yes - every correctional officer remembers his first prison riot ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42179537/b3220da2cc469cf5790ab1b2bdeaeff7c851bd77.gif[/img]

It was fierce and nice action oriented event, don't you think? ;)
We had fun setting it up and neutralizing inmates - it was so different from other , let's call it "static" prison guard's routines. Also we noticed that you - the Players -  very liked this riot event so we decided: "why not make a full game just with prison riots :D "


[h2]Some details about Ready for Riot[/h2]

In this game you will take a role of a member of special police assault group and your main goal will be 
to take over a prison from rioting prisoners. Why so many USA prisons have constantly riots nowadays? Maybe this is somehow  connected? You need to solve this case too ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42179537/25c92d6547c30fd6d6ca14a8559348226b0a3f0f.jpg[/img]

But this game will me more action-oriented than story-oriented. So call your friends, it's game time!
You can play alone but we will design it to better play coop mode. Currently we will try to make it up to 4 players but it can change.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42179537/cc4d7a220d9eff978c2ac0f42862ed2172a5ffd5.gif[/img]

Four players means four different aproach: 4 is classic "team number". There will be some minor and major changes between character's classes like you know a one with shield, a DPS and healer. Of course every player can use tools that suit them perfectly but some classes will be better at this and that ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42179537/57b3b90370c635199ea0e129a3380cccd7d0c3cd.gif[/img]

Prisoners in riots will try to suprise you from every corner - well they spend some years in this facility, they now this buliding better than anyone else ;) You must be aware of traps and being ambushed and also remember that prisoners can steal some dangerous tools from workshop and use them against you! Also some of them will even carry guns stolen from guard's towers and rifle range!! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42179537/e50a36de1866fbc6042cb505f6c7d23f9bff0892.gif[/img]

Your main objective will be neutralise all dangerous prisoners but... you know it's sounds  actually horrific! They are still human beings, right? 
We still are wondering how to develop this. We got some ideas like two types of ammo - lethal and non-lethal. Non-lethel will do less damage and knocked out prisoners can wake up. And lethal - well you know, nobody wake up from shot in the head. And neutralising inmates with non-lethal will be more scored but harder to achieve. But it's still in tests so it will probably change.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42179537/bc8185531d3ba0569f32da4d9bcbb7ada361b32f.jpg[/img]


There will of course some more info soon ;) 
Feel free to ask us in comments below or join our discord community with over 3000 members!
Also check out our cool trailer on YouTube ;)
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VgQAJZBr-es

So, are you [b]ready[/b]? [b]Ready for Riot[/b]!

Best regards,
Baked Games Team
